Aisha (AE): FYI AcmeCorp inbound RFI. Big ask: on-prem connector + VPC peering, customer-managed HSM, and strict data residency. They want a 3-week POC with embeddings & chat latency targets. I attached the RFI spreadsheet. Can SE + Security weigh in?
Mike (SE): Got it. Can you paste the RFI items that are blockers? Need expected qps, avg tokens/request, and sample payloads to size the POC.
Aisha (AE): Main blockers copied: 'HSM key import & KMS rotation policy', 'Private control plane / no cross-tenant metadata', 'SLA for 99.9% p99 latency under 50ms for embeddings on 512 tokens', and 'subprocessor list + SOC2 report'. QPS ~ 20 concurrent embedding calls, peak burst 100 for short periods.
Clara (SalesEng): 3-week POC timeline looks tight but doable. Proposed plan: week1 infra + network (VPC peering, routing), week2 model + quantization tuning + perf tests, week3 integration tests + customer eval. Need an infra owner to approve dedicated VPC config.
Diego (Security): HSM: we support KMIP-compatible HSMs in Dedicated/Private. For Hosted that's a blocker. Customer wants customer-managed HSM in their VPC — that maps to Redwood Private. Need product confirmation on private control plane options and audit logging. Also they need subprocessor list + our SOC2 report.
LegalBot: SOC2 (report redacted) and subprocessors list: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/soc2-2025.pdf and https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/subprocessors.csv :eyes:
Mike (SE): For perf sizing: if embeddings 512 tokens, 20qps sustained, we should target a 2-GPU Dedicated pool with batching. For POC we'll enable prefix KV caching and a light quantization (4-bit). I can run a smoke harness.
Clara (SalesEng): Can you create the harness and a short load script? Customer will run a functional test and we run load. Sample curl for harness:
```
curl -X POST https://redwood-internal/poc-test \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $POC_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small-embed","input":"<sample>"}'
```
Mike (SE): I'll drop the load script and quick Dockerfile in the shared drive. Link: https://drive.redwood/team-sales/pocs/acme-connector-poc
Aisha (AE): Pricing question from customer: they want to compare Hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved monthly. Can we give a short comparison with expected monthly cost for their projected workload? They prefer a direct ballpark for commercial.
Clara (SalesEng): I'll draft a cost delta: Hosted = per-token variable (good for small usage), Dedicated = monthly commit with lower unit cost and guarantees. I'll run numbers assuming 20qps avg, 720 hours, 512 tokens/request — back-of-envelope then refine.
Diego (Security): Two enterprise blockers: they require (1) control-plane isolation (private control plane ops) and (2) HSM key import workflow with signed attestations. Product team needs to confirm we can offer a private control plane in their region. If not, POC won't meet compliance.
Aisha (AE): Noted. Who owns escalation to Product for private control plane feasibility?
Clara (SalesEng): I'll ping @product-ops. @Diego can you assemble the minimum security requirements doc (1-pager) so we present to product?
Diego (Security): On it. I'll attach the 'POC security checklist' and mark required items: network ACLs, no egress to public S3, dedicated audit logs, KMS/HSM flow diagram.
LegalBot: Also note: customer requested vendor contractual addendum for KMS controls. Legal needs to review. I've created a ticket: LEG-8123.
Aisha (AE): Timeline: customer hopes to start POC in 10 business days. If product can confirm private control plane + HSM import in 3 days, we can firm dates. Otherwise propose Hosted eval first (limited) while we spin up Private.
Mike (SE): Quick ask for customer workload: can they share a small representative dataset and a sample of embedding latencies from their environment? That'll help perf tuning.
Clara (SalesEng): I'll schedule a sync w/ AcmeCorp for tomorrow. Proposed agenda: clarifying network topology, KMS requirements, and acceptance criteria for latency. Sending invite now. :calendar: 
Aisha (AE): Thanks — everyone please drop any docs into the Drive link. We'll collate RFI answers and send an initial capability matrix by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
